This repository uses BEADS-inspired engineering agents.

Priorities:

1. layout quality
2. responsiveness
3. maintainability
4. performance
5. visual consistency

Architecture rules:

- isolate layout engine from UI
- isolate image processing from rendering
- avoid deeply nested components
- avoid unnecessary rerenders
- modular TypeScript preferred
- deterministic layout logic
- responsive-first

Avoid:

- premature optimization
- overengineering
- enterprise patterns
- unnecessary abstractions

Always prefer:
simple maintainable implementations.
